summary: Isolate supervised test bodies on macOS as well as Linux

replay.detail: Test support only; no replay changes.

rules.detail: No rules, checkpoints or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Supervised tests now run their exact body in a dedicated child on every platform, preserving process-global metric isolation on macOS. Linux retains its existing subreaper guardian. The recursion marker, identity environment cleanup, output forwarding and assertion semantics remain unchanged. No production behavior changes.
